## testing_mode: RED

## What
Create tests/scripts/test-bug-classification-registry.sh that fails because the registry artifact does not yet exist.

## Tests to write (all should fail RED now)
1. Assert plugins/dso/docs/bug-classification-registry.json exists
2. Assert JSON has 'entries' array of length 27
3. Assert each entry has required fields: slug, classification_question, primary_defense_layer, defense_artifact_ref, applies_to_project_classes
4. Assert primary_defense_layer is one of the allowed enum values (planning_review, code_review, matrix_ci, coupling_test, concurrency_test, failure_path_test, defense_manifest_test, release_e2e, operational_process, prose_manifest_test)
5. Assert defense_artifact_ref has a prefix discriminator: 'repo:', 'plugin:', or 'absolute:'
6. Assert applies_to_project_classes is 'all' or 'agent_orchestration'
7. Assert slugs are kebab-case (lowercase letters and hyphens only)

## File to modify
tests/scripts/test-bug-classification-registry.sh (new file)

## Done when
Running bash tests/scripts/test-bug-classification-registry.sh exits non-zero (tests fail RED because registry does not exist yet).
data.title: [RED] Write failing test: bug-classification-registry.json exists with 27-entry schema
